item.title: High-Level Rust: Getting 80% of the Benefits with 20% of the Pain
item.description:
📝 There is no programming language that has it all: Expressive types Good Community Good ecosystem Good perf Good devx Several get close, but they're all missing something. Can we move about as fast with Rust as we would another language. High Level Rust So I had this idea - what if you could just write Rust as a high-level language.
🔗 Read more: https://hamy.xyz/blog/2026-01_high-level-rust
